# Structure seed atlas (generated by tools/find-structure-seeds.mjs, seeds 0-200)

Seeds use generation chunk-manager type default. Origin is the finite/streamed world origin chunk (spawn chunk minus 4); the finite world covers chunks [origin, origin+8) on both axes (128x128 blocks). Spawn is the native world spawn of a generation 18+ streamed world (world-spawn.js, the grass-top random walk from findBiomePosition); the origin chunk is its chunk minus 4 and the streamed view centres 64 blocks inside the origin, so the player starts near the spawn block. (Batch 72: earlier versions of this atlas approximated the spawn as origin + 64.) Coordinates are block X,Z at the start chunk centre (chunk*16+8). Only sizeable starts are listed (village needs more than 2 non-road pieces).
